title: 10 Mathematics KCPE 2012
text:
THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATION COUNCIL
 KCPE 2012
 TIME;2HRS
 MATHEMATICS
 READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY
 1. You have been given this question booklet and a separate answer sheet.The question booklet
 contains 50 question
 2. Do any necessary rough work in this booklet
 3. When you have chosen your answer,mark it on the ANSWER SHEET,not in this booklet
 4. Use only an ordinary pensil
 5. Make sure that you have written on the answer sheet:
 YOUR INDEX NUMBER
 YOUR NAME
 NAME OF YOUR SCHOOL
 6.By drawing a dark line inside the correct numbered boxes mark your full index number[i.e school
 code number and the three –figure candidate’s number] in the grid near the top of the answer sheet.
 7. DO not make any mark outside the boxes
 8.Keep the sheet as clean as possible and do not fold it
 9.For each of the question 1-50 four answers are given.The answers are lettered A,B,C and D.IN each
 case only ONE of the four answers is correct.Chose the correct answer
 10. On the answer sheet the correct answer is to be shown by drawing a dark line inside the box in
 which the have chosen is written.
 EXAMPLE
 In the question booklet:
 11.What is the value of 6(24-18) + 6×4?
 A. 30
 B. 25
 C. 10
 D. 28
 The correct answer is C (10)
 On the answer sheet:
 1 [A] [B] [C] [D] 11. [A] [B] [C] [D] 31. [A] [B] [C] [D] 41.[A] [B] [C] [D]
 In the set the box with the letter D printed in it is marked.
 11. Your dark line must be within in the box.
 12. For each quaton only one box is to be marked in each set of the four boxes.
 1. What is 20075803 written on words?

 B. Two hundred millions seventy five thousand egght hundred and three
 C. Twenty millions seven hundred fifty eight hundred and three.

 A. 66

 11. A ndona bought 50 pineapples at sh 30 each and paid 100 for transport to the market. During
 transportation 5 pineapple got spoilt. She sold the rest at sh 50 each. What percentage profit did
 he make?
 A. 56 ¼
 B. 46 7/8
 C. 43 1/3
 D. 40 5/8
 12. Interschool soccer competition started at 3.15p.m.After 45 minute,players went for 15 minutes
 break. The game then took 55 minutes to end. At what time in the 24 hours system did the game
 end?
 A. 17 10h
 B. 05 10 h
 C. 16 55 h
 D. 16 30 h
 13. The figure below represent the net of a solid.
 The net is folded to form the solid. How many edges will the solid have?
 A. 4
 B. 5
 C. 8
 D. 12
 14. The table below shows the number of people who attend an agriculture show.
 Males adult Female adult children
 986 3145 5807
 How many more children than adults attended the show?
 A. 1676
 B. 2662
 C. 4131
 D. 4821
 15. A kiosk owner bought 10 litres of milk on Monday.On Tuesday and Wednesday, a total of 20 litres
 were bought. Equal numbers of litres were bought on Thursday and Friday. Altogether 120 litres
 were bought during the 5 days. In a pie chart,what angle would represent the amount of milk
 bought on Friday?
 A. 300
 B. 900
 C. 1500
 D. 1800
 16. Two pickups were used to collect garbage from a market. Each pickup carried 2 tonnes 300 kg of
 garbage per trip. Each pickup was to make 5 trips. After the fourth trip one of the pickups broke
 down and did not carry the garbage. What was the total mass of the garbage collected?
 A. 23 tonnes 0 kg
 B. 20 tonnes 700kg
 C. 18 tonnes 400 kg
 D. 11 tonnes 500 kg
 17. A company gives a commission on sales above sh 100 00. In a certain month a salesgirl received a
 commission of 36000 after selling goods worth sh 800 00. What was the percentage commission
 offered?
 A. 36
 B. 4
 C. 4 ½
 D. 5 1/7
 18. Paint was stored in three containers of 48 litre,72litres and 30litres. The paint in each container
 was then repacked into smaller containers. The amount of paint in each of the smaller containers
 was the same. What was the capacity of the lagerst container used to repack the paint?
 A. 3litres
 B. 6litres
 C. 72litres
 D. 720litres
 19. Jane gave money to her three children. She gave 1/3 of the total amount to the first child and 2/5
 of the remainder to the second child. She was left with sh 2400 which gave to the third child. How
 much money did she gave out altogether?
 A. Sh 9 000
 B. Sh 6 000
 C. Sh 4 000
 D. Sh 3 600
 20. The mean mass of four pupils was 49.5kg. When when the masses of another pupil and a teacher
 were included,the mean mass became 53kg. If the mass of the pupil was 16 kg less than of the
 teacher, what was the teachers mass?
 A. 44kg
 B. 52kg
 C. 76kg
 D. 68kg

 P to meet line RS at T.
 Q R

 A. 4.

 22. In the year 2008 there were in a school of whom 3/5 were boys. In the year of 2009,ten girls joined
 the school and twenty boys transferred to another school what was the ratio of boys to girls in the
 school, in the year of 2009?
 A. 3 : 2
 B. 53 : 33
 C. 13 : 8
 D. 7 : 5
 23. A famer harvested 900bags of maize . She sold 0.7 0f the bags and gave 0.1 of the remainder to a
 charitable organasation then kept the rest. How many bags of maize were kept?
 A. 27
 B. 180
 C. 243
 D. 270
 24. What is the value of x in 3 (x + 4 )- 10=32?
 A. 16 2/3
 B. 12 2/3
 C. 11 1/3
 D. 10
 25. In a right angled triangle the length of hypotenuse is 40cm. Which one of the following pairs are
 the possible length of the two shorter sides?
 A. 12cm, 5 cm
 B. 25cm , 15cm
 C. 24cm, 7cm
 D. 32cm , 24cm
 26. M uli obtained a total score of 180 marks in English, Mathematics and Science. His score in English
 is a half the score obtain in Mathematics. The score in Mathematics was 10 more than the score
 obtained in science. If the score obtained in science is represented by x, which one of the equation
 below can be used to get the value of x?
 A. 2 ½x + 15 = 180
 B. 2 ½ x – 15 = 180
 C. 4x + 30 = 180
 D. X + 15 = 180
 27. The table below shows inland postal charges for letters.
 Weight of letters Sh Cts
 Up to 20g 25 00
 Over 20g up to 50g 30 00
 Over 50g up to 100g 35 00
 Over 100g up to 250g 50 00
 Over 250g up to 500g 85 00
 Over 500g up to 1kg 135
 Over 1kg up to 2 kg 190 00
 Wamu posted two letters each weighing 95g and another one weighing 450g. How much money
 did he pay at the post office?
 A. Sh 120
 B. Sh 135
 C. Sh 155
 D. Sh 240
 28. A trader deposited Sh 300 at a bank that paid a compound interest at the rate of 5%p.a. How much
 money was in her account in the bank, at the end of two years?
 A. Sh 330 750
 B. Sh 330 000
 C. Sh 315 000
 D. Sh 30 750
 29. On a map of scale 1: 100 000 a rectangular plot of land measures 7cm by 4cm. What are the actual
 length of the plot in kilometers?
 A. 70 000 by 40 000
 B. 700 by 400
 C. 70 by 40
 D. 7 by 4
 30. The number of tree seedlings planted in the certain season increased by 20%. If there were 24000
 seedlings planted in that season ,how many seedlings were there before increase?
 A. 19 000
 B. 20 000
 C. 28 800
 D. 30 000
 31. Which quadrilateral has all yhe properties listed below?
 All sides are equal
 All angles are right angles
 Diagonals are equal
 Diagonals bisect each other at right angles
 A. Square
 B. Trapezium
 C. Rectangle
 D. Rhombus
 32. Kioko bought the following items to donate to a charitable organization
 2 bags of cabbage @ sh 25 00
 4 bags of potatoes @ sh 2000
 20 kg of cooking oil for shs 2000
 100kg of sugar @sh 96
 50 loaves of bread @ sh 35
 He was given a 10% discount for all his purchases. How much did he pay for the items?
 A. Sh 23 715
 B. Sh 26 350
 C. Sh 57 915
 D. Sh 28 985
 33. Musa and Kayai left Town P for Town Q at the same time.Musa drove at an average speed of
 80knm/h and reached town Q after 3 hours. Kayai drove at an average speed of 50km/h for 1 ½ hrs
 and then continued with the journey at an Average speed of 70km/h. How many kilometers had
 kayai to cover at the time Musa reached town Q?
 A. 240
 B. 180
 C. 165
 D. 60

 28m

 how many days less would it take the painters working at the same rate to paint the houses?
 A. 24

 C. 4
 D. 3

 2 (x +2y ) -2y

 A. 10 ½ x
 B. 2 ½ x
 C. 13 ½ x
 D. 21x
 45. The cash prize of a radio is Sh 8000. The hire purchase price is 50% more than the cash price.
 Amina bought a radio on hire purchase by paying a deposit of Sh 2400 and equal monthy

 A. 18
